name: Darth Nox's Fury-class Imperial interceptor
description: The Sith Lord later known as Darth Nox was given a Fury-class Imperial interceptor by the Sith's master, Darth Zash, during the search for the artifacts of Tulak Hord. Kallig, as the Sith was first known, continued to use the ship even after leaving Zash's apprenticeship.
